- For total cholesterol, the latest value was 227.6 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 208.8 to 209 and then 227.6 mg/dL. [B-R10, B-R11, B-R12]
- For blood sugar (glucose), the latest value was 112.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 104.8 to 107.4 and then 112.3 mg/dL. [B-R10, B-R11, B-R12]
- For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), the latest value was 157.5 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went from 171.1 to 178.9 and then 157.5 mg/dL. [B-R10, B-R11, B-R12]
- The other test results did not raise an alert. [B-R08, B-R12]

BLOOD PRESSURE AND HAEMOGLOBIN
- Blood-pressure screening was normal, with the latest reading being 132/86 on 2021-11-07, which is below 140/90. [B-R11, B-R12]
- Anaemia screening was also normal, showing a haemoglobin level of 13.6 g/dL on 2018-10-21, which is at or above 12 g/dL. [B-R08]

YOUR MEDICINES AND ALLERGIES
- Your ongoing medications include lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet, Hydrochlorothiazide 25 MG Oral Tablet, and insulin human isophane 70 UNT/ML / Regular Insulin Human 30 UNT/ML Injectable Suspension [Humulin]. [B-R02, B-R07]
- No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

POINTS TO DISCUSS WITH YOUR DOCTOR
- You can talk with your doctor about your kidney health test trends, your blood sugar levels, and your cholesterol numbers. [B-R10, B-R11, B-R12]
